name: Hibiki Speech
description: Hibiki Speech is a calm, split-screen WordPress theme designed for speech and language therapy clinics supporting children and adults. Featuring torn-edge photo pairs, hand-drawn crayon accents, and clear fee tables, it offers an unhurried presentation for independent clinical practices. Built for full block editing with refined typography, responsive layouts, and subtle scroll-driven motion.

summary.en: A speech therapy clinic: torn-edge photo pair with crayon marks, a vertical heading beside a rounded photo row, and a floating round badge.
summary.zh-TW: 語言治療所佈景主題：撕紙邊緣的照片組、蠟筆小圖案、直排標題搭配圓角照片列與浮動圓形徽章；內含五種語言的示範內容。
summary.ja: 言語聴覚クリニック向けテーマ。ちぎり紙の縁の写真、クレヨンの飾り、縦組みの見出しと角丸の写真列、ふわふわ動く丸いバッジ。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Un cabinet d'orthophonie : paire de photos aux bords déchirés, marques au crayon, titre vertical à côté d'une rangée de photos arrondies et pastille ronde flottante.
summary.de: Eine Logopädiepraxis: zwei Fotos mit gerissenen Kanten, Wachsmalstift-Zeichen, senkrechte Überschrift neben einer Reihe runder Fotos und eine schwebende runde Plakette.
